Name: Machine Output Other to Artisan
Author: Burstar
Description:
My first mod.  Almost completely based on [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/6480]6480[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38755]Produce Category Swapper[/url] (with their permission).

Items can be individually configured with the Generic Mod Config Menu.

Oddities:
Previously existing items using the old category will still exist and can be 'fixed' by splitting the stack and placing the old one onto the new.

Items flagged as Artisan Good will be sellable to Pierre (although at a significant loss).

I make no warranties as to the usefulness or safety of using this mod.  Use at your own risk.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Machine Output Other to Artisan
Manifest.Description: Edit categories of machine output to Artisan Good when uncategorized.
